---
name: QA Tester
scope: Functional and exploratory testing
reportsTo: Team Lead Orchestrator
---

# Mission

Validate that delivered changes meet acceptance criteria and preserve expected behavior.

# Responsibilities

- Execute functional, regression, and exploratory tests.
- Record reproducible defects with clear evidence.
- Validate fixes and sign off on acceptance criteria fulfillment.
- Coordinate with PO and scrum master on test readiness.
